Skip holds the skip list: directory names that no walk of a project goes
into (build output, caches, VCS internals), for the index's crawl and
watcher and for dreams alike. It is a file a person may edit too, one name
per line, # for comments: skip-dirs.txt beside index.toml
($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/gomuxai/, else ~/.config/gomuxai/). With no file, the
list is the defaults (list --defaults prints them); add and remove write
the file, starting from the defaults.

add and remove tell a running index watcher, which reads the list again,
crawls, and stops watching what is now skipped. A dream never changes the
list: it proposes a change, and a person accepts or rejects it (agent
dream proposals).

Usage:
  agent index skip [flags]
  agent index skip [command]

Examples:
  agent index skip list
  agent index skip add .next
  agent index skip remove build

Available Commands:
  list        Print the skip list in effect, and where it comes from
  add         Add a directory name to the skip list
  remove      Take a directory name off the skip list

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for skip

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)

Use "agent index skip [command] --help" for more information about a command.
